errors.workspace_required: export: a workspace id is required (nothing scopes boards/tasks without one)
errors.export_init_script: export the init script of project {project}
errors.code_missing: the bundle names {path} as the code of project {project}, but the archive does not have it
errors.board_owned_elsewhere: board {id} already exists here in workspace {workspace}; importing it into {target} would take it away from its tasks. Import into {workspace}, or into another install
errors.project_owned_elsewhere: project {id} already exists here in workspace {workspace}; importing it into {target} would take it away from its tasks. Import into {workspace}, or into another install
errors.task_owned_elsewhere: task {id} already exists here in workspace {workspace}, and an import does not move existing tasks to {target}. Import into {workspace}, or into another install
errors.board_owned_by_fallback: board {id} already exists here in {workspace}, the workspace nobody owns that keeps what this install did before it had workspaces. An import moves it to {target} only when {target} is the only workspace and {workspace} has no projects or tasks. Import into another install
errors.project_owned_by_fallback: project {id} already exists here in {workspace}, the workspace nobody owns that keeps what this install did before it had workspaces, and an import does not move it to {target}. Import into another install
errors.task_owned_by_fallback: task {id} already exists here in {workspace}, the workspace nobody owns that keeps what this install did before it had workspaces, and an import does not move it to {target}. Import into another install

hints.credential_reenter: stored encrypted; re-enter on the new host and re-grant to its projects/environments
hints.ingest_token_reissue: write-only; reissue on the new host and update whatever CI holds OCTOPUS_INGEST_TOKEN

labels.restore_boards: boards, their stages and task types
labels.restore_secrets: secrets and ingest tokens — re-entered by hand, see the checklist
labels.restore_tasks: tasks (rows, then attachments, comments, reports, events, test cases and their runs)
labels.restore_init_scripts: project init scripts (the current revision of each)

warnings.public_url_skipped: skipped {key}: set it to this host's own public address
warnings.test_case_key_taken: test case {key} ({id}) on task {task}: the key is taken by another case, skipped with its runs
